scope: Standardized motor-side phase current, 1.4 A reserve. Four real signed route schedules include yaw and translational inertial forcing at the same time as finite pipe contact and pan acceleration. An actual scoring-panel field capture, installed mechanism inertia/efficiency and motor controller calibration are separate. Commanded motor current and voltage are modeled; no physical hardware was run.
